item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Doksuri is expected to intensify into a super typhoon, and it will move towards the Luzon Strait in the next couple of days. It may move towards the coast of eastern Guangdong afterwards. There is also a chance of edging closer to the vicinity of the southern part of Taiwan. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be persistently very hot over southern China midweek this week. Showers and squally thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. Unsettled weather associated with Doksuri is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week, and it will be windy over the region.
